findings: Module-level and ordinary-import-accessible token, session key, evidence factory, append, and seal attributes permit a caller to compose V1 acceptance authority.
Evidence HMAC validation does not independently replay exact HELLO, envelope, ACK, result, attempt-receipt, module/argv/environment, and raw anonymous-pipe authority semantics.
The V1 classifier treats an ordinary unsealed result directory as honest_incomplete instead of commit_indeterminate.
V1 live-closure verification returns only a path tuple and does not bind the complete predecessor plus self path-to-SHA256 mapping into every evidence and commit.
Publication adversarial coverage is incomplete for exact truth-table states, post-success readback, aliases, cross-session/replay/swap, and synchronized tamper.
